import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_49/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_49/test_1.csv"
    ]

    # Columns as per target schema (and source schemas, which are identical)
    target_columns = [
        'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime', 'start station id', 'start station name',
        'start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station id', 'end station name',
        'end station latitude', 'end station longitude', 'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
    ]

    # Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
        # Ensure columns are exactly as target columns and in the same order
        df = df[target_columns]
        dfs.append(df)

    # Since all source tables have the same schema as the target,
    # we can concatenate (union) them directly
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Enforce data types as per target schema:
    # 'tripduration': integer
    combined_df['tripduration'] = combined_df['tripduration'].astype(int)

    # 'starttime' and 'stoptime': string (keep as is, but ensure string type)
    combined_df['starttime'] = combined_df['starttime'].astype(str)
    combined_df['stoptime'] = combined_df['stoptime'].astype(str)

    # 'start station id', 'end station id', 'bikeid', 'birth year', 'gender': integer
    combined_df['start station id'] = combined_df['start station id'].astype(int)
    combined_df['end station id'] = combined_df['end station id'].astype(int)
    combined_df['bikeid'] = combined_df['bikeid'].astype(int)
    combined_df['birth year'] = combined_df['birth year'].astype(int)
    combined_df['gender'] = combined_df['gender'].astype(int)

    # 'start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station latitude', 'end station longitude': float
    combined_df['start station latitude'] = combined_df['start station latitude'].astype(float)
    combined_df['start station longitude'] = combined_df['start station longitude'].astype(float)
    combined_df['end station latitude'] = combined_df['end station latitude'].astype(float)
    combined_df['end station longitude'] = combined_df['end station longitude'].astype(float)

    # 'usertype': string (keep as is)
    combined_df['usertype'] = combined_df['usertype'].astype(str)

    # Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_49/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
